bug_semantics: openstack_auth.views.login() copies request.GET['next'] into Django's server-side session as post_login_redirect before authentication. The assignment marks the session modified, so SessionMiddleware persists a new backend entry and Set-Cookie for every unauthenticated GET /auth/login/?next=URL that lacks a session cookie. Repeated requests exhaust Memcached/Redis/DB session storage, evicting legitimate sessions (unauthenticated DoS). HorizonMiddleware._process_request still early-returns for unauthenticated users (the CVE-2014-8124 guard), but the new view-layer write runs after request middleware and bypasses it. CWE-696 incorrect behavior order; regression of CVE-2014-8124.
flaw_origin: The first write is commit 3e2ff4e063fb46dc2a790670648dc6e1ca9b5a79 ('Horizon save URL after okta login', Gerrit 950302 / Change-Id Ia4835fcdb25021af714a34ac785115b4f1f476fb). It added openstack_auth/views.py login() lines that do request.session['post_login_redirect'] = next_url on unauthenticated GET, plus a websso() pop of that key. Immediate parent 827a566d349020853e0370b6bf90066dd56b6ec2 has no post_login_redirect anywhere. The Okta/WebSSO redirect was stored in the session instead of a cookie, which is the flawed mechanism.
